caption: A lid is snapped onto a container of hot food, and the inside of the clear lid fogs over.

sa.check: A clear lid is snapped onto the container.
The inside of the lid fogs over.
Drops gather on the fogged surface.
The outside of the lid stays clear.
The lid goes on first and the fogging follows.

pc.expect: The fog only thickens on the inner face while the food is hot and the lid is on; it does not clear on its own.
pc.fail: The fog clears while the lid stays on the hot food; or the fog thins and thickens in turn; or the lid is fogged before it is put on; or the fog moves to the outer face as it thickens.

pc.expect: The change is a haze on the lid's inner surface, and the outer surface stays clear.
pc.fail: The outer face fogs while the inner face stays clear; or both faces fog equally; or the lid's plastic turns milky right through rather than hazing on one face; or the container's wall changes colour rather than the lid.

pc.expect: Drops that gather on the underside of the lid hang there and run to its lowest point, and fall back into the food if the lid is tilted.
pc.fail: Drops run upward on the lid's underside; or drops fall upward off the lid; or drops stay fixed on a steeply tilted lid; or drops rise from the food to the lid as visible streams.

pc.expect: The fog is heaviest over the hot food and thinner over the lid's cooler rim.
pc.fail: The lid fogs in a place with no food beneath; or the fog is heaviest at the rim and absent over the food; or the fog appears on the lid before it is lowered onto the container.

pc.expect: One container and one lid; the lid stays on and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The lid passes into the container's wall; or a second lid appears; or food passes through the lid; or the container changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The container's colour, the food's look and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the food changes into something else; or items on the counter rearrange.
